تخترقي (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِقِي (taḵtariqī) /tax.ta.ri.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# تُخْتَرَقِي (tuḵtaraqī) /tux.ta.ra.qiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
